brief:
Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Falih Al-Zaidi called for the establishment of a sovereign Palestinian state during his address at the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly, Al Jazeera English reported.

The call comes as the Israeli-Palestinian conflict continues to dominate international discourse, with numerous countries using their UNGA platforms to address the situation in Gaza and the occupied territories.
dek: Iraqi Prime Minister Ali Falih Al-Zaidi called for a sovereign state of Palestine at the 81st session of the UNGA.
title: Iraq calls for sovereign Palestinian state at UN General Assembly
